question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**positive**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is the story of 'The Grasshopper and the Ant'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**positive**'.
 
• Here, **'on the positive note' **is **a phrase.** It means '(to finish) with an optimistic tone, with good news'. [(समाप्त करने के लिए) एक आशावादी स्वर के साथ, अच्छी खबर के साथ]
 
 
• *Example: I should like to end on a **positive** note.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *The value that comes out of the story The Grasshopper and the Ant has to be subtly put to the children in such a way that they realise the worth of hard work, the pleasures of hard work and the comfort it offers. Laziness, which is a negative trait here, should be discouraged, while emphasizing on the **positive** note which is hard work.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **important**: having great value or influence; very necessary. (महत्वपूर्ण; अत्‍यावश्‍यक)
 
• **essential**: completely necessary; that you must have or do. (परमावश्‍यक; सर्वथा अपेक्षित)
 
• **critical**: saying what is wrong with somebody/something. (दोषदर्शी, आलोचनात्‍मक)
